rosie.intro: Turn on Regex Keepsakes (or a board, report, or HEX/SELARU module) in the preset, and Rosie writes these short bracket tags. The regexes draw them as cards.

groups.title: Keepsakes
groups.intro: Small cards Rosie drops into the story.

scripts.name: 🌹 Rosie Scene Compass
scripts.syntax: [RSCENE: title | place | time | present | mood | thread | nudge]
scripts.blurb: A pink fold-out card for the current scene: place, time, who's present, mood, the live thread, and a one-line nudge. Tap the title to open it.

scripts.name: 💌 Rosie Ship Ledger
scripts.syntax: [RSHIP: pair | stage | heat | obstacle | payoff | note]
scripts.blurb: A card for a pairing: where they stand, the heat, what's in the way, the payoff it's building to, and a note.

scripts.name: 📱 Rosie Phone Message
scripts.blurb: Draws a text message as a phone screen, with the contact, time, delivery status, and message bubble.

scripts.name: 🧭 Rosie Quest Card
scripts.blurb: A quest card: the current step, what comes next, the risk, and the reward.

scripts.name: 🎁 Rosie Inventory Keepsake
scripts.blurb: An item card: who owns it, what shape it's in, and what it means to them.

scripts.name: 👗 Rosie Wardrobe Card
scripts.syntax: [RWARDROBE: character | outfit | posture | detail | mood | note]
scripts.blurb: What a character is wearing right now, with their posture, one telling detail, and their mood.

scripts.name: 🗣️ Rosie Rumor Board
scripts.blurb: A rumor: who started it, who it's about, what's being said, how far it's spread, and what it'll cost.

scripts.name: 💞 Rosie Relationship Map
scripts.syntax: [RREL: title | person_a | person_b | bond | tension | note]
scripts.blurb: Two people side by side, with the bond between them and the tension in it.

groups.title: Info boards
groups.intro: Dashboards from the Info Board System. Each one also has an "Always Fire" module.

scripts.name: 📋 Rosie General Info Board
scripts.syntax: [RBOARD: title | subtitle | left label | left value | right label | right value | note]
scripts.blurb: A general-purpose board: a title, two labeled values side by side, and a note.

scripts.name: 📍 Rosie Status Board
scripts.syntax: [RSTATUS: title | location | time | pressure | danger | objective | next]
scripts.blurb: The scene at a glance: location, time, pressure, danger, the objective, and what's next.

scripts.name: 👥 Rosie Cast Board
scripts.syntax: [RCAST: title | active | nearby | absent | wild card | note]
scripts.blurb: Who's in the scene, who's nearby, who's missing, and the wild card.

scripts.name: 🧠 Rosie Knowledge Board
scripts.syntax: [RKNOW: title | character | knows | suspects | does not know | risk]
scripts.blurb: What one character knows, suspects, and doesn't know, and the risk hiding in the gap.

scripts.name: 🕯️ Rosie Calendar / Countdown Board
scripts.syntax: [RCLOCK: title | date | time | deadline | event | note]
scripts.blurb: The date and time, with a countdown to the next deadline or event.

scripts.name: 🗂️ Rosie Case Board
scripts.syntax: [RCASE: title | lead | evidence | suspect | contradiction | next]
scripts.blurb: A mystery case file: the lead, the evidence, the suspect, the contradiction, and the next step.

scripts.name: 👑 Rosie Reputation Board
scripts.syntax: [RREP: title | public read | allies | threats | gossip | consequence]
scripts.blurb: How the world sees a character: the public read, allies, threats, gossip, and consequences.

groups.title: Status reports
groups.intro: F.A.Y.E.-inspired reports. Turn on the Status Report System and pick a style.

scripts.name: 🌹 Rosie SFW Status Report
scripts.syntax: [RSFWREPORT: title | when/where | mood | pressure | thread | next opening | rosie note]
scripts.blurb: A styled status report card for the scene, with Rosie's note at the bottom.

scripts.name: 🌹 Rosie SFW Markdown-Style Status
scripts.syntax: [RSFWMD: title | when/where | mood | pressure | next opening | rosie note]
scripts.blurb: A lighter, quote-style version of the same report.

scripts.name: 🫦 Rosie Velvet Heat Report
scripts.syntax: [RVELVET: title | adult check | privacy | heat | consent/boundaries | emotional risk | aftercare | next opening | rosie note]
scripts.blurb: The adults-only report for intimate scenes: adult check, privacy, heat, consent and boundaries, emotional risk, and aftercare.

scripts.name: 🫦 Rosie Velvet Markdown-Style Status
scripts.syntax: [RVELVETMD: title | adult check | privacy | heat | consent/boundaries | next opening | rosie note]
scripts.blurb: A lighter, quote-style version of the Velvet Heat Report.

scripts.name: 🌹 Rosie AI Affinity Status Board
scripts.syntax: [RAFFINITY: status | affection % | change | attraction % | change | loyalty % | change | intelligence % | change | intrigue % | change | understanding you | perceived threats | sweet things | sad things | internal monologue]
scripts.blurb: The big screenshot-style panel: five stats with their latest changes, what the character understands about you, perceived threats, sweet and sad things, and an internal monologue.

groups.title: HEX- and SELARU-style boards
groups.intro: Alternate board styles inspired by HEX's environmental boards and SELARU's in-world objects. Commands like [ROSIE:HEX INFO] call them up.

scripts.name: 🔥 Rosie HEX-Style Info Board
scripts.syntax: [RHEXINFO: date | season | start time | end time | location | temperature | weather/visibility/light | illumination | scene pressure]
scripts.blurb: An environmental board: date, season, how much time passed, location, temperature, weather, light, and scene pressure.

scripts.name: 🔥 Rosie HEX-Style Affinity Board
scripts.syntax: [RHEXAFF: focus | thought/meta read | mood | affinity | heat/tension | physical state | soundtrack | scenery]
scripts.blurb: An affinity board for one character: their read on things, mood, affinity, tension, and physical state, plus a soundtrack and a scenery line.

scripts.name: 🌹 Rosie HEX-Style SFW Affinity Board
scripts.syntax: [RHEXAFFSFW: focus | public read | mood | affinity | tension | posture | soundtrack | scenery]
scripts.blurb: The SFW version: public read, mood, affinity, tension, and posture.

scripts.name: 🫦 Rosie HEX-Style Velvet Affinity Board
scripts.syntax: [RHEXAFFNSFW: focus | adult check | privacy | heat | consent/boundaries | arousal/tension | physical state | aftercare/aftermath | note]
scripts.blurb: The adults-only version, with an adult check, privacy, heat, consent and boundaries, and aftercare.

scripts.name: 🪞 Rosie SELARU-Style Diegetic Info Board
scripts.syntax: [RSELINFO: object type | title | source | visible text/detail | interaction | consequence | character reaction]
scripts.blurb: Shows information as an object in the story world, like a sign, a note, or a screen: what it says, how it's used, and how the character reacts.

scripts.name: 🪞 Rosie SELARU-Style Affinity Evidence Board
scripts.syntax: [RSELAFF: pair/focus | visible evidence | private/public status | trust | pressure | risk | next opening]
scripts.blurb: Affinity told through evidence you could actually see instead of a number: what's visible, whether it's public, trust, pressure, and risk.

scripts.name: 📜 Rosie SELARU-Style Document Board
scripts.syntax: [RSELDOC: document type | title | issuer/source | contents | seal/status | consequence | note]
scripts.blurb: An in-world document such as a letter, contract, or decree, with its issuer, contents, seal, and consequence.

scripts.name: 🖥️ Rosie SELARU-Style Terminal Board
scripts.syntax: [RSELTERM: interface | status | signal/source | message | warning | action prompt | consequence]
scripts.blurb: An in-world terminal or device screen, with its status, message, warning, and an action prompt.

groups.title: Behind the scenes
groups.intro: These hide things rather than draw them.

scripts.name: 🌹 Rosie Secret Stitch Note
scripts.blurb: Takes Rosie's private continuity notes out of the reply and files them in the rosie_notes chat variable, so they're remembered but never shown.

scripts.name: 🌹 Rosie Chekhov Plant
scripts.blurb: Files a planted setup (a Chekhov's gun) in the rosie_planted chat variable instead of showing it.

scripts.name: 🌹 Rosie Chekhov Fired
scripts.blurb: Logs a payoff in the rosie_fired chat variable when a planted setup goes off.

scripts.name: 🌹 Rosie HTML Marker Cleanup
scripts.blurb: Removes the invisible ROSIE_HTML start and end markers around Rosie's HTML panels.

scripts.name: 🌹 Rosie Macro Cleanup
scripts.blurb: Hides any leftover {{addvar}}, {{setvar}}, {{getvar}}, {{incvar}}, or {{decvar}} macros so they never show up in a reply.

scripts.name: 🌹 Rosie Prefill Strip
scripts.blurb: Removes a "[Continuing in-character…]" prefill if the model echoes it at the start of a reply.

vigil.intro: Turn on 🧵 Loom Mode in the preset, and Vesper writes these light tags instead of full HTML. It's cheaper on tokens and keeps the look consistent.

scripts.name: VV - Chapter Plate
scripts.blurb: A centered chapter plate: the number and title in small caps over an italic epigraph.

scripts.name: VV - Scene Ledger
scripts.blurb: The Scene Ledger: when, where, who's present, and the open threads.

scripts.name: VV - Ribbon Ledger
scripts.syntax: <ribbon>Name ♦ Affection NN Stage ♦ Desire NN Stage ♦ Trust NN Stage</ribbon>
scripts.blurb: The Ribbon Ledger for one bond: Affection, Desire, and Trust meters, each with its number and stage.

scripts.name: VV - Ribbon Delta Chip
scripts.blurb: A small inline chip for a change to a bond, with the reason.

scripts.name: VV - Vesper Remark
scripts.blurb: Vesper's signed remark under a reply, in her burgundy margin style.

scripts.name: VV - Reading Room Patron
scripts.blurb: One Reading Room reader's reaction, with their @handle.

scripts.name: VV - Crossroads Fork
scripts.blurb: Draws each of Vesper's Crossroads options as a pill-shaped choice.

scripts.name: VV - Night Reading Veil
scripts.blurb: Wraps the model's reasoning in a 🕯️ "the night reading" fold-out, so it doesn't sprawl across the reply.

lovesick.intro: Turn on 📶 Signal Mode in the preset, and Juno writes these light tags instead of full HTML. It's cheaper on tokens and keeps the look consistent.

scripts.name: LS - Chapter Card
scripts.blurb: A chapter card with its number and title over an italic epigraph.

scripts.name: LS - The Receipts
scripts.blurb: The Receipts: when, where, who's there, and the threads in play.

scripts.name: LS - The Pinboard
scripts.syntax: <pinboard>when ♦ where ♦ the room ♦ fit check ♦ the vibe ♦ threads ♦ up next</pinboard>
scripts.blurb: The detailed scene board: when, where, the room, fit check, the vibe, threads, and what's up next. It replaces The Receipts when both are on.

scripts.name: LS - Group Chat Name
scripts.blurb: The group chat's name, as a header above its messages.

scripts.name: LS - Group Chat Message
scripts.blurb: One group chat bubble with the sender's name.

scripts.name: LS - Delulu Meter
scripts.syntax: <delulu>Name ♦ Feelings NN Stage ♦ Heat NN Stage ♦ Honesty NN Stage</delulu>
scripts.blurb: The Delulu Meter for a pairing: Feelings, Heat, and Honesty bars, each with its number and stage.

scripts.name: LS - Delulu Delta Chip
scripts.blurb: A small inline chip for a change to Feelings, Heat, or Honesty, with the reason.

scripts.name: LS - Juno Comment
scripts.blurb: Juno's signed comment under a reply, liveblogging your love life.

scripts.name: LS - What They Didnt Say
scripts.blurb: A 🤫 fold-out holding the line someone didn't say out loud.

scripts.name: LS - The Firsts
scripts.blurb: A 💌 fold-out checklist of the relationship's firsts, done and not yet.

scripts.name: LS - Needle Drop
scripts.blurb: A small "♪ now playing" line for the scene's song.

scripts.name: LS - Margin Notes (think)
scripts.blurb: Juno's readable reasoning: wraps <think> in a 🖊️ "juno's margin notes" fold-out. You don't need it if SillyTavern's Auto-Parse Reasoning already catches <think> tags.

callboard.intro: CALLBOARD writes data lines, like TW> msg|… for a Twitch message, inside [[SHELL]] tags. Row regexes draw each line, and shell regexes draw the window around them. They ship inside the preset: allow them when SillyTavern asks, or import the bundle.

groups.title: Dividers
groups.intro: These also work in your own messages.

scripts.name: CB · Divider — Act Break
scripts.blurb: Turns the line into a ✦ ✦ ✦ act break.

scripts.name: CB · Divider — Scene Shift (⁂)
scripts.blurb: Turns it into a centered scene-shift mark.

scripts.name: CB · Divider — Timeskip (↷)
scripts.blurb: Turns it into a "later" timeskip divider.

groups.title: Cue Calls and The Program
groups.intro: New in v1.4: Xavi tells you what's about to appear, and what's lit tonight.

scripts.name: CB · Cue — standby slip (with legend)
scripts.syntax: CUE> icon|what's coming|why now|what it means
scripts.blurb: A gold ● STANDBY slip above whatever's about to appear, with a "What it means" legend. Xavi includes the legend the first time each kind of element shows up.

scripts.name: CB · Cue — standby slip
scripts.blurb: The same STANDBY slip without the legend, for elements you've already seen.

scripts.name: CB · Cue — catch-all (malformed lines)
scripts.blurb: Catches cue lines with the wrong number of fields and shows them as a plain STANDBY line.

scripts.name: CB · Shell — The Program
scripts.blurb: The theatre-program card listing everything that's lit. It appears on the first reply of a chat, and whenever you send [PROGRAM].

scripts.name: CB · Program row — title
scripts.blurb: The program's title: tonight's production in a phrase.

scripts.name: CB · Program row — cast line
scripts.syntax: PG> cast|wing · mode · patter and mood
scripts.blurb: The line under the title: the setting wing, mode, and Xavi's patter and mood.

scripts.name: CB · Program row — act
scripts.syntax: PG> act|icon|module|what sets it off|what you'll see
scripts.blurb: One lit module per line: what sets it off (CUE) and what you'll see.

scripts.name: CB · Program row — note from Xavi
scripts.blurb: A closing note from Xavi to the director, signed — X.

scripts.name: CB · Program row — catch-all (malformed lines)
scripts.blurb: Catches program lines with the wrong number of fields and shows them as plain text.

groups.title: Xavi
groups.intro: Your stage manager's notes and asides.

scripts.name: CB · Callboard — style think foldout
scripts.blurb: Shows Xavi's reasoning as a 🎧 "Xavi at the board" fold-out.

scripts.name: CB · Callboard — hide think from prompt
scripts.blurb: Leaves Xavi's <think> notes out of what's sent back to the model on later turns, to save tokens. What you see doesn't change.

scripts.name: CB · Xavi — curtain note (style)
scripts.blurb: Xavi's curtain note: a 🎧 card under the reply.

scripts.name: CB · Xavi — curtain note (hide from prompt)
scripts.blurb: Leaves Xavi's curtain notes out of what's sent back to the model, so they cost no tokens later.

scripts.name: CB · Xavi — OOC aside (style, AI output only)
scripts.blurb: Styles Xavi's (OOC: …) asides as a "from the wings" note signed — X. It only touches the AI's replies, so your own OOC stays plain.

groups.title: Tracker and boards
groups.intro: Written inside one <cb_state> block. Shell regexes draw each card, and row regexes draw the lines inside it.

scripts.name: CB · Tracker shell

scripts.name: CB · Tracker row — line

scripts.name: CB · Tracker row — affinity

scripts.name: CB · Tracker row — reputation

scripts.name: CB · Board row — Status
